**Verdict: reject** (tier1 — no autonomous merge).

The underlying task substance actually succeeded: I confirmed independently via `gh api` that PR #89's real conflict in `ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml` was resolved sensibly (merge commit `ffa86b8`, both sides' registry text combined) and PR #89 now shows `mergeable_state: clean`. That work was correctly pushed directly to PR #89's own head branch (appropriate for conflict resolution, not a violation of the "never push to main" rule).

But the diff actually up for review/merge here isn't that work — it's a leftover artifact: a broken git submodule/gitlink (`pr89-work`, no `.gitmodules`) accidentally swept into this task's checkpoint commit from the worker's scratch clone directory. Merging it would put a dangling, unmapped gitlink into `claude-control` master with zero functional value. Rejected with instructions to `git rm --cached pr89-work` and gitignore the scratch clone instead. Written to `review-verdict.json`.
